title: ARI Report v0.1
description: Third-party-verifiable Agent Reproducibility Index report. Carries per-condition HER/Hbar, the aggregate ARI, an optional (s,b,kappa) fingerprint, and an environment manifest required by spec/condition-set.md.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the agent/model under test, e.g. 'openai/text-embedding-3-large'.

input_content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the ordered input records — pins the exact inputs the report was produced on. Enforced by leaderboard/scoring/score.py: the hash must equal the input set's published content hash, or the hash of a prefix of it. A prefix run is accepted but recorded as `comparable: false` on the leaderboard, because a reduced run and a full run are not the same measurement.

measured_at.description: Date the measurement was taken (YYYY-MM-DD). The leaderboard shows this per row, so a reader can tell a fresh number from a stale one. Carried from the report rather than stamped at scoring time, because when a row was scored is not when it was measured.

agent_class.description: Determines how 'same' is validated. self_hosted: deterministic agent, 'same' is the probe-purity control and must be 1.0. api: black-box agent that may itself be non-deterministic, so 'same' is a measured within-session-determinism axis (any value in [0,1]). Absent → self_hosted. Decoding classes: 'vendor' (closed model served by its maker), 'rehosted' (open weights served by a third party), 'platform' (a proxy door in front of a vendor model). For all three, 'same' is a measured floor, never required to be 1.0.

encoder_fingerprint.description: The (s, b, kappa) model fingerprint. Optional but recommended; lets verifiers predict E[H](sigma) = kappa * sqrt(2*dim/pi) * sigma without re-running the sweep.

environment.description: Environment manifest for the baseline condition E0. Required for third-party verifiability (spec/condition-set.md).

results_per_condition.description: One entry per measured condition (spec/condition-set.md). Each condition either reports a single result directly (v0.1 shape, an implicit 'semq' detector) or nests one or more named detectors under 'detectors' (multi-detector shape, see $defs/conditionResult). For agent_class=self_hosted, 'same' is the probe-purity control and must be 1.0 for the 'semq' detector; for agent_class=api, 'same' is a measured within-session-determinism axis (any value in [0,1]).

ARI.description: Aggregate index: mean HER over the present comparable-core conditions {proc, conc, time}. mach/prec/lib are reported per-condition as diagnostics but are not averaged into ARI (they are not measurable for a black-box API, so folding them in would break cross-class comparability).

ARI_R.description: ARI-R = 1 - mean coordinate_change_rate over the present comparable-core conditions. Removes the dimension from the denominator; it does not make sensitivity model-independent (see spec/ari-canonical-v0.2.md). ARI keeps its exact-match (HER) meaning. Added in v0.2.

drift_spectrum.description: Optional per-condition histogram of per-input Hamming distances.

audit_hashes.description: SHA-256 digest of the code matrix per condition (inputs in fixed ARI-Bench order). Compact, order-sensitive audit record; a third party re-running the protocol recomputes the same digest per condition (exactly for a deterministic agent).

layer.description: Which ARI layer this report measures. Determines the headline detector the scorer re-checks: representation -> detectors.semq.HER; decoding -> detectors.exact_generation.value. Absent -> representation.

detectorResult.description: One detector's result for one condition, plus the metadata needed to judge what it can see.

Hbar.description: Mean Hamming drift in bits — a count of differing code bits, not of differing bytes and not of differing coordinates. SEMQ QUANT packs several coordinates into one byte, so those are three different numbers.

bits_per_coordinate.description: Code bits one coordinate occupies under the probe's configuration. Added 2026-09-10; absent from reports produced before that date, which are not re-signed.

n_coordinates.description: Coordinates per encoded unit. The denominator of a coordinate change rate. Added 2026-09-10.

n_bits.description: Code bits per encoded unit, n_coordinates * bits_per_coordinate. The denominator of bit_hamming_rate. Excludes the padding of a final partial byte. Added 2026-09-10.

coordinate_change_rate.description: rho: mean over inputs of the fraction of the encoder's dim coordinates whose code symbol changed (never padding coordinates). Under ARI-Canonical-v0.2 it does not fall with dimension the way HER does; it still depends on the model's coordinate distribution and the perturbation (spec/ari-canonical-v0.2.md). Added in v0.2.

coordinate_change_rate_ci.description: Bootstrap 95% CI of coordinate_change_rate over inputs. Added in v0.2.

criterion_type.description: Whether a verdict needs calibration: 'exact' (bit/vector equality — no calibration needed), 'interval' (a bounded overlap measure), 'threshold' (needs a calibrated null floor, e.g. cosine similarity, before a verdict can be read off it).

bytes_of_reference_state.description: Bytes of reference state that must be retained per unit to evaluate this detector (e.g. a SEMQ code's packed size, or dim*4 for a raw fp32 vector). An integer derived from the encoder/detector, never a hardcoded constant.

unit.description: What this detector compares: a SEMQ code, a raw embedding vector, or a ranked retrieval list.

change_profile.description: Retired in ARI v0.2: the harness no longer writes this block, because the public SEMQ SDK has no quant_regions to bound movement with. Kept so reports written 2026-09-10 onward still validate. Extent and location of the change, and its quantized movement where the probe could bound it; not a measure of functional harm.

coordinate_change_rate.description: Fraction of coordinates whose symbol changed. Not a byte rate.

group_sizes.description: Coordinates in each block; the final block may be short.

displacement.description: Quantized movement over ordered value regions. n_unbounded counts coordinates in a saturated region, whose movement has no finite upper bound.

bound_quality.description: How informative the movement bounds are, under the generic codec guarantee. Every rate names its denominator: _of_all covers every coordinate compared, _of_changed only those whose symbol changed, and a rate over changed coordinates is null when none changed. These are results for the probe and intervention measured, not constants of the method. Added 2026-09-11.

finite_width_quantiles.description: Quantiles of the finite interval widths, keyed pNN.

finite_width_basis.description: Which coordinates the width quantiles were taken over.

norm_bound_quality.description: Bounds that hold only under a declared assumption about vector norms, reported separately from the generic bounds and carrying the assumption they rest on. Absent when no assumption was declared. Added 2026-09-11.

assumptions.description: The declared norm constraint and its provenance. Must be non-empty: a norm block without its assumption is not interpretable.

thresholds.description: For each predeclared movement threshold, the counts definitely below, definitely above, and unresolved. A threshold on the representation, not on functional harm. Added 2026-09-11.

basis.description: Which coordinates the counts were taken over.

oneOf.description: v0.1 shape: a single implicit 'semq' result directly on the condition.

achieved_in_flight.description: For the 'conc' condition when a provider's rate tier caps the burst below the panel-wide 64: the in-flight count actually sustained (spec/arid-bench-v0.1.md §6). Recorded so a capped row is not read as if it ran at 64.

oneOf.description: Multi-detector shape: one or more named detectors, each with its own result and metadata.

additionalProperties.description: Which form applies follows from the detector, not the layer: the 'semq' probe reports detectorResult (HER/Hbar over codes); sequence-level detectors (exact_generation, first_divergence, topk_logprob_overlap) report genericDetectorResult (a bounded value over completions).

achieved_in_flight.description: For the 'conc' condition when a provider's rate tier caps the burst below the panel-wide 64: the in-flight count actually sustained (spec/arid-bench-v0.1.md §6). Recorded so a capped row is not read as if it ran at 64.

timeEvidence.description: Evidence that a 'time' result compares two captures more than 24 hours apart with everything else held fixed (spec/condition-set.md, Time evidence). This is the embedding form; a report with layer 'decoding' uses decodingTimeEvidence. Both captures are timestamped in UTC, and the timestamps decide the gap. The held-fixed settings are recorded once, since both captures share them, and must match the report's own. Optional in the schema so reports signed before it existed still validate; python -m ari.check_evidence rejects a 'time' result that lacks it, and ari/verify_report.py warns.

baseline_started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the baseline encode began.

baseline_finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the baseline encode ended.

comparison_started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the comparison encode began.

comparison_finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the comparison encode ended.

gap_hours.description: (comparison_started_at - baseline_finished_at) in hours, rounded up to 0.01 so that it exceeds 24 exactly when the timestamps do. Must be finite and agree with the timestamps within 0.01; the evidence check rejects NaN and infinity, which JSON Schema cannot.

agent_id.description: Agent both captures encoded; must equal the report's agent_id.

input_content_hash.description: Content hash of the inputs both captures encoded; must equal the report's input_content_hash.

probe_calibration.description: Canonical probe id both captures used; must equal the report's probe_calibration. Under ARI-Canonical-v0.2 the scale is 2/sqrt(dim), so the evidence check also requires encoder_fingerprint.dim and an encoder_fingerprint.s equal to 2/sqrt(dim) to 6 decimals.

model_revision.description: Immutable model revision loaded by both captures. For agent_class self_hosted (or absent), a full 40-character lowercase hex Hub commit id. For a hosted agent_class (api, vendor, rehosted, platform), the provider's model id, with its snapshot id when one exists, or 'provider-internal'. The evidence check rejects branches, tags, short ids and placeholders such as 'main', 'unknown', 'pinned' or 'floating'.

tokenizer_revision.description: Immutable tokenizer revision; equals model_revision when the tokenizer ships in the model repository. The same rules as model_revision apply.

precision.description: Numeric precision of both captures; must equal environment.precision. 'provider-internal' only for a hosted agent_class.

hardware.description: Hardware both captures ran on; must equal environment.hardware. Self-hosted: architecture, CPU model and GPU names, not the hostname or OS version. 'provider-internal' only for a hosted agent_class.

sdk_version.description: semq package version that encoded both captures; must equal environment.library_versions.semq when the report records it. Never 'provider-internal'.

baseline_source_commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex git commit of the harness code that ran the baseline capture. Not held fixed: it may differ from source_commit. Never 'provider-internal': the harness is ours to record for every agent_class.

source_commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex git commit of the harness code that ran the comparison capture. Never 'provider-internal'.

deviations.description: Differences from the procedure, one per entry. A cell with deviations is not a clean canonical capture: python -m ari.check_evidence fails it and ari/verify_report.py warns. The capture tools never write it.

decodingTimeEvidence.description: The decoding-layer form of timeEvidence, for a report with layer 'decoding' (spec/arid-bench-v0.1.md). Built from the two 'same' runs' manifest entries (experiments/arid-dry-run/run_dry.py). Holds fixed the requested model, the prompt set, the protocol id and the request; records each run's harness commit and provider-reported model versions without holding them fixed. ari/verify_report.py requires this form when the report's layer is 'decoding' and the embedding form otherwise.

baseline_started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the baseline encode began.

baseline_finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the baseline encode ended.

comparison_started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the comparison encode began.

comparison_finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the comparison encode ended.

gap_hours.description: (comparison_started_at - baseline_finished_at) in hours, rounded up to 0.01 so that it exceeds 24 exactly when the timestamps do. Must be finite and agree with the timestamps within 0.01; the evidence check rejects NaN and infinity, which JSON Schema cannot.

agent_id.description: Agent both captures encoded; must equal the report's agent_id.

input_content_hash.description: Content hash of the inputs both captures encoded; must equal the report's input_content_hash.

protocol.description: ARI-D protocol id both runs followed (arid-bench-v0.1); must equal environment.library_versions.protocol when the report records it.

model.description: Model id both runs requested; must equal environment.library_versions.model_requested when the report records it.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the request template both runs sent (endpoint and body with the prompt as a placeholder: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, seed and the rest). The manifest keeps the template itself.

precision.description: Always 'provider-internal' for a hosted decoding row; must equal environment.precision.

hardware.description: Always 'provider-internal' for a hosted decoding row; must equal environment.hardware.

baseline_model_versions.description: Model versions the provider reported for the baseline run (for example Gemini modelVersion, OpenAI model). Recorded, not held fixed: a backend change between runs is what the condition shows.

model_versions.description: Model versions the provider reported for the comparison run.

baseline_source_commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex git commit of the harness code that ran the baseline capture. Not held fixed: it may differ from source_commit. Never 'provider-internal': the harness is ours to record for every agent_class.

source_commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex git commit of the harness code that ran the comparison capture. Never 'provider-internal'.

deviations.description: Differences from the procedure, one per entry. A cell with deviations is not a clean canonical capture: python -m ari.check_evidence fails it and ari/verify_report.py warns. The capture tools never write it.

genericDetectorResult.description: A sequence-level detector's result for one condition (decoding layer): a bounded value instead of the semq HER/Hbar pair.

value.description: The detector's bounded statistic (e.g. byte-identical pair rate, mean normalized first-divergence position).

criterion_type.description: Whether a verdict needs calibration: 'exact' (bit/vector equality — no calibration needed), 'interval' (a bounded overlap measure), 'threshold' (needs a calibrated null floor, e.g. cosine similarity, before a verdict can be read off it).

bytes_of_reference_state.description: Bytes of reference state a verifier needs. Sequence detectors need none: 0.

unit.description: What one comparison unit is, e.g. 'completion_pair', 'byte_position'.
